questions.answer:
An AEO program, as this site describes it, covers five areas:

- **Visibility baseline:** choosing the questions your buyers ask and checking which brands each AI assistant cites today [3].
- **Content structure:** rebuilding pages around direct, self-contained answers and question-based headings [3].
- **Entities and schema:** consistent organization, person, service and medical schema, plus off-site signals that identify your business to AI systems [3].
- **Technical access:** AI crawler rules, server-rendered content, llms.txt and page speed [3].
- **Reporting:** citation share

questions.answer: SEO is a long-term investment, and timelines depend on your starting point, competition, and goals. Technical fixes and quick wins can show impact within weeks, and meaningful organic traffic growth typically appears between three and six months. Substantial, compounding results are often visible at six to twelve months [1]. Visibility in AI systems can shift faster, since those platforms update their knowledge bases more often [1].
